sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000046-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Northstar Urgent Care 046 on November 20, 2024.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 2.5%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 760 Tdap doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: declined by the Customer.
